title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
AN450
Current Topics in Anthropology
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
An examination of current debates and topics in sociocultural anthropology.
Students
engage in project
design, develop a research proposal by way of an ethics
application, and assemble a literature review relevant to
their topic of choice. Those subsequently taking
AN452
* can
carry out their research project to fruition.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
AN200
.
